description_en: Queries the details of inter-region connections under an Enterprise Edition transit router by calling the ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments operation

name: ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Enterprise Edition transit router instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。默认值为20，最大值为100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token that determines the start point of the query. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no subsequent query is to be sent, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a subsequent query is to be sent, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

Once specified, the tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

The tag value can be an empty string or up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag information.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that determines the start point of the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query is to be sent.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the Enterprise Edition transit router instance automatically advertises routes of the inter-region connection to the peer region.

false (default): No.
true: Yes
AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_zh:
企业版转发路由器实例是否自动发布跨地域连接的路由到对端地域。

false（默认值）：否。
true：是

Bandwidth.description_en:
The bandwidth value of the inter-region connection. Unit: Mbit/s.

If BandwidthType is set to BandwidthPackage, this parameter indicates the bandwidth that the inter-region connection can use.
If BandwidthType is set to DataTransfer, this parameter indicates the bandwidth limit of the inter-region connection
Bandwidth.description_zh:
跨地域连接的带宽值。单位：Mbps。


当BandwidthType取值为BandwidthPackage时，该参数表示跨地域连接可使用的带宽值。
当BandwidthType取值为DataTransfer时，该参数表示跨地域连接的限速带宽值

BandwidthType.description_en:
The bandwidth allocation method. Valid values:

BandwidthPackage: Bandwidth is allocated from a bandwidth package.

DataTransfer: No bandwidth is allocated to the inter-region connection. Data transfer is pay-as-you-go
BandwidthType.description_zh:
带宽的分配方式。取值：

BandwidthPackage：从带宽包中分配带宽。

DataTransfer：不为跨地域连接分配带宽，按使用流量计费

CenBandwidthPackageId.description_en: The ID of the bandwidth package associated with the inter-region connection
CenBandwidthPackageId.description_zh: 跨地域连接绑定的带宽包ID

CreationTime.description_en:
The time when the inter-region connection was created.

The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`
CreationTime.description_zh:
跨地域连接的创建时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`

DefaultLinkType.description_en:
The default link type.

Gold (default): gold.
Platinum: Platinum
DefaultLinkType.description_zh:
默认链路类型。

Gold（默认值）：金。
Platinum：铂金

GeographicSpanId.description_en: The connected areas of the bandwidth package

PeerTransitRouterId.description_en: The instance ID of the peer transit routing router

PeerTransitRouterOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the account to which the peer transit router instance belongs
PeerTransitRouterOwnerId.description_zh: 对端转发路由器实例所属账号ID

PeerTransitRouterRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the peer transit router instance
PeerTransitRouterRegionId.description_zh: 对端转发路由器实例所属地域ID

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router
RegionId.description_zh: 企业版转发路由器所属地域ID

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of resource associated with the connection.

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.
CCN: Cloud Connect Network instance.
VBR: virtual border router (VBR) instance.
TR: transit router instance
ResourceType.description_zh:
连接所关联的资源类型。

VPC：专有网络实例。
CCN：云连接网实例。
VBR：边界路由器实例。
TR：转发路由器实例

Status.description_en:
The status of the inter-region connection.

Attached: attached.
Attaching: being attached.
Detaching: being detached.
Detached: detached
Status.description_zh:
跨地域连接的状态。

Attached：已加载。
Attaching：加载中。
Detaching：卸载中。
Detached：已卸载

TransitRouterAttachmentDescription.description_en: The description of the inter-region connection
TransitRouterAttachmentDescription.description_zh: 跨地域连接的描述信息

TransitRouterAttachmentName.description_en: The name of the inter-region connection

TransitRouterId.description_en: The Enterprise Edition transit router instance ID
TransitRouterId.description_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID
